cases.question: What drives the forecast the most?
cases.answer: The top driver of the 24-hour forecast is the measured minus CAMS nowgap (`cams_gap`), with a mean SHAP value of 7.05. This is followed by the CAMS forecast for the target hour (`fut_cams_pm25`) at 3.96 and forecast wind speed (`fut_wind_speed`) at 3.11.

cases.question: Why does the model use CAMS as an input if CAMS is wrong?
cases.answer: CAMS is used as an input because, even if it has errors, it provides valuable large-scale atmospheric and transport signals that the model can correct. In fact, our live track record shows the model beats CAMS in 69 of 72 days, with an overall skill vs CAMS of 0.467 (and a backtest mean skill vs CAMS of 0.47).
